title: Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Handling for Failed Child Order Submissions
precondition: Sub-account #42 order fails due to momentary socket timeout.
steps: 1. Route failed child order to DLQ.
expected: DLQ consumer initiates exponential retry (3 attempts); recovers fill status without manual intervention.
coverage_note: Requires infrastructure hooks, a different account population, distributed nodes, gateway idempotency contract, or long-duration load tooling not supplied.
